login.title: 로그인

registration.title: 계정 정보
registration.tos: PRUNplanner는 무료입니다. 계정을 만들면 {tos_link}을 이해하고 동의한 것으로 간주됩니다.

result.throttled: Too many registration attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
result.unknown: Unknown error. Please try again later.

form.username_info: 최소 3글자 이상이어야 합니다. 공백은 사용할 수 없습니다.
form.password_info: At least 8 characters, not only numbers, and not a common password.
form.email_info: Only used to reset your password if you forget it. No newsletters, never shared. You can add it later in Profile.
form.email_invalid: This doesn't look like an email address. Leave it empty or fix it to create your account.
form.question: {planet} 행성의 이름을 입력하세요. 이름을 확인하려면 {command} 명령어로 Prosperous Universe에서 새 버퍼를 여세요. 행성 정보의 '이름' 항목에서 행성 이름을 확인할 수 있습니다

password_reset.title: 비밀번호 재설정
password_reset.info: 이메일로 전송된 코드와 새로운 비밀번호를 입력하세요.
password_reset.throttled: 시도 횟수가 너무 많습니다. 잠시 기다린 후 다시 시도해 주세요.

request_password_reset.title: 비밀번호 재설정 요청
request_password_reset.info: PRUNplanner 계정과 연결된 인증된 이메일 주소를 입력하세요. 확인한 후 비밀번호를 재설정할 수 있는 코드를 보내드리겠습니다.
request_password_reset.throttled: 시도 횟수가 너무 많습니다. 잠시 기다린 후 다시 시도해 주세요.
request_password_reset.error: 요청이 실패하였습니다. 잠시 후 다시 시도해 주세요.

verify_email.title: 이메일 인증
verify_email.info: 이메일로 전송된 인증 코드를 입력해 주세요. 스팸함을 확인해야 할 수도 있습니다.

result.already_verified: Your email address is already confirmed.

none.title: Add an email so you can't get locked out
none.body: If you ever forget your password, an email is the only way back to your plan. none.body_plain: If you ever forget your password, an email is the only way back to your plans. It is only used for password resets: no newsletters, never shared.

unconfirmed.title: Confirm your email
unconfirmed.body: Password resets only go to a confirmed address. Enter the code we sent to {email}, or ask for a new one.

email_nudge.never_toast: No more reminders. You can add an email any time in Profile.
email_nudge.code_sent: Code sent. Check your inbox, and your spam folder.

email_dialog.email_info: Only used to reset your password. No newsletters, never shared. You can change or remove it any time in Profile.
email_dialog.email_code_info: We'll send an 8-character code to confirm it's yours.
email_dialog.code_info: We sent a code to {email}. It's valid for 24 hours. You can also click the link in the email, on any device.
email_dialog.done_info: If you forget your password, use “Forgot password” on the login screen and we'll send the reset to {email}.
email_dialog.confirmed_toast: Email confirmed. Password resets now go to {email}.

errors.invalid_email: This doesn't look like an email address.

errors.expired: That code has expired. Send a new one.
errors.no_code: There is no code waiting for this account. Send a new one.
